steps.title: Setup: Get Old Examinee from dashboard
Setup: Create New Examinee 1 + assign Broad Achievement
Setup: Create New Examinee 2 + assign Broad Achievement
Setup: Assign Broad Achievement to Old Examinee
S1: Open New Examinee 1 → capture baseline + verify 9 tests
S1: Open Old Examinee → verify test list matches
S1: Re-open Old Examinee → verify still intact
S1: Open New Examinee 2 → verify test list matches
S1: Re-open New Examinee 2 → verify test set still intact
S2 Setup: Create custom test set with 19 tests
S2 Setup: Assign custom test set to New Examinee 1
S2 Setup: Assign custom test set to New Examinee 2
S2 Setup: Assign custom test set to Old Examinee
S2: Open New Examinee 1 (custom) → capture baseline + verify 19 tests
S2: Open Old Examinee (custom) → verify
S2: Re-open Old Examinee (custom) → verify still intact
S2: Open New Examinee 2 (custom) → verify
S2: Re-open New Examinee 2 (custom) → verify test set still intact
S3: Semi-administer Calculation for New Examinee 1 (default test set)
S3: Open Old Examinee (default) → verify NO in-progress carryover
S3: Open New Examinee 1 in Review Mode (from dashboard) → verify Calculation is In Progress
S3: Reopen New Examinee 1 from dashboard → verify left nav + in-progress status
S3: Complete the in-progress Calculation test (5 wrong → ceiling)
S3: Enter Review Mode → verify Calculation now Complete + test list = 9
S4: Open Old Examinee (custom) → verify 19 tests + semi-administer Calculation
S4: Open New Examinee 2 (custom) → verify NO in-progress carryover
S4: Open Old Examinee in Review Mode (from dashboard) → verify Calculation In Progress + 19 tests
S4: Reopen Old Examinee → verify left nav + complete Calculation
